narrative.overview: ClinicSync treats clinic operations software as a crisp paper medical chart digitized without ornament. Triage receptionists, physicians, and outpatients share one strictly light-only interface anchored by a bright sage-mineral navigation rail (#EAEFED), a coastal porcelain canvas (#F4F7F6), exam-paper surfaces (#FFFFFF), 1px cool-stone hairlines (#DCE3E1), and Clinical Teal (#0F766E) action controls.
keyCharacteristics: Strictly light-only polarity matched to clinic desks and exam rooms.
1px stone hairlines and hairline ledger strips instead of decorative shadows or nested cards.
Tabular Geist Mono numerals across queue tickets, vitals, and encounter identifiers.
Minimum 44px hit targets on mobile triage controls, slot pickers, and modal dismissals.

rules.name: The Single-Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve saturated semantic hues strictly for status badges, active allergy alerts, and live calling actions.

rules.name: The Strict Heading Ladder Rule
rules.body: Pages carry a single H1 inside PageHeader; card sections use H2; sub-entries inside cards use H3.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Cards Rule
rules.body: Never nest bordered rounded cards inside cards; separate inner groupings with 1px hairlines.

dos: Do use .cs-num (tabular-nums) on every queue number, vital sign, timestamp, and encounter ID.
Do keep neutral ink contrast at #14201E or #465854 (>= 4.5:1 on light surfaces).
Do pair every desktop table with a screen-reader caption, scope="col" headers, and mobile stacked cards.
donts: Don't introduce dark mode toggles, glassmorphism blurs over workspace cards, or >1px left/right border stripes.
Don't place eyebrow kickers directly above H1 page headings.
Don't show arrival guidance on completed, cancelled, or no-show appointments.
